title: Void Ware V3.5
features:
Has auto grief, anti vamp (automatically on), boombox id stealer (automatically on, prints in dev console), auto weird morph. For the item givers, you need enlighten and you have to place down a green block with spray that says "bkit" or "fly" or whatever you want and then if players step on it it works.
As far as universal goes - Fly, Noclip, and so much more. Adding custom colors soon! Made by greenerds14-art on github. I had permission to reupload this.
